captchaProblem.body: We couldn't run the check that keeps robots out. Reload the page and try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.linkSent: If {{email}} has an account, an email with a sign-in code and link is on its way. Enter the code below, or open the link in this browser. Asking again replaces both, so use the newest email.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.sent: Check {{email}} for a code to confirm your account. Enter it below, or open the link in the email in this browser.
signUp.consent: By creating an account you agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

resend.wait: Didn't get it? You can ask for another email in {{seconds}} seconds.
resend.noEmail: Still no email? Check your spam folder. If you may already have an account, sign in or reset your password instead.
resend.sent: Sent again. Use the newest email: it replaces the earlier one.

callback.title: Signing you in
callback.freshCode: Opening the link used it up, but you can sign in here with a new code. Enter your address and we will email one.
callback.freshReset: Opening the link used it up, but you can finish here with a new code. Enter your address and we will email one.
callback.codeSent: If {{email}} has an account, a new code is on its way. Enter it below. Use the newest email.

errors.invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match. Check them, or email yourself a sign-in link.
errors.email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email first. We can send the confirmation email again.
errors.weak_password: Choose a longer password: at least 8 characters.
errors.wrong_password: That is not your current password. If you don't have one, use Forgot password on the sign-in page.
errors.same_password: That is your current password. Choose a different one.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.captcha_failed: We couldn't confirm you're not a robot. Wait for the check to finish, then try again.
errors.link_invalid: The link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
errors.link_other_browser: Open the link in the same browser where you asked for it. If you were confirming a new account, your email is now confirmed: sign in here.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
errors.code_invalid: That code is wrong, already used or expired. Check the newest email, or request a new one.
errors.totp_invalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Enter the code your authenticator app shows now.
errors.totp_locked: Too many wrong codes, so you have been signed out. Wait 15 minutes, then sign in again.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your account email and we will send a code and link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If {{email}} has an account, an email with a reset code and link is on its way. Enter the code below, or open the link in this browser. Asking again replaces both, so use the newest email.

change.title: Change your password
change.hint: At least 8 characters. Your other devices are signed out.
change.noPassword: Never set a password? Reset it by email

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.noSession: This reset link or code is no longer valid. Request a new one.

code.label: {{length}}-digit code
code.hint: From the email we just sent. Works even if you read the email on another device.

code.label: {{length}}-digit code
code.hint: From your authenticator app. A new code appears every 30 seconds.

enrol.title: Set up two-step sign-in
enrol.intro: Sign in with a code from an authenticator app (such as 1Password, Google Authenticator or Authy) as well as your password.
enrol.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
enrol.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
enrol.secret: Can't scan it? Enter this key instead:

challenge.title: Enter your code
challenge.intro: Open your authenticator app and enter the code for this account.

verified.title: Two-step sign-in is on
verified.body: This session is verified with your authenticator app.

unenrol.code: Current {{length}}-digit code, to remove the app
unenrol.title: Remove your authenticator app?
unenrol.description: You won't be able to use the platform console until you set one up again.

invite.title: Joining your team
invite.invalid: This invitation is not valid for the account you are signed in as. It may have expired, been used or been withdrawn.
invite.invalidHelp: Ask the person who invited you to send a new one, or sign out and open the link again with the email address it was sent to.
invite.full: The team you were invited to has used all the people its plan includes, so you could not be added yet.
invite.fullHelp: Ask the owner to upgrade the plan or free up a seat, then open the invitation link again. It stays valid until it expires.

operator.switchDescription: Pick your name, then enter your PIN.
operator.noCandidates: Nobody here has set a PIN yet. Sign in as yourself and choose Set my PIN.
operator.wrongPin: That PIN didn't work. After 5 wrong tries a person is locked out for 5 minutes.
operator.pinDescription: 4 to 8 digits. You use it to switch in on a shared tablet. Not 0000 or 1234.
operator.pinInvalid: Use 4 to 8 digits that aren't all the same or a run like 1234.

apps.title: Authenticator apps
apps.two: Add a second authenticator app (on another device) so losing one phone never locks you out. There are no recovery codes.

org.title: Business setting
org.label: Require 2FA for owners and admins
org.hint: Owners and admins without a verified session can still run the queue but cannot change settings, export data or delete anything.
org.needsCode: Verify with your authenticator app first: this setting needs a two-step session.
org.ownersOnly: Only an owner can change this.
org.failed: Couldn't change the setting. Check that you verified with your authenticator app, then try again.

ticket.eta: About 4 to 6 min · 2 ahead of you
ticket.title: Your line, under control.
ticket.body: Guests join from a link or QR code. You call the next one.

join.body: No app, no account for guests.

display.body: Put a TV on the wall.

payments.v: Take a card at the door
